concept.title: Reference topics
concept.abstract: This chapter provides a comprehensive guide to DITA reference topics, which are designed for presenting structured, factual, and lookup-oriented information such as APIs, configuration parameters, system requirements, supported platforms, checklists, and technical specifications. It explains the use of reference-specific elements, tables, parameter lists, API and CLI semantic markup, and advanced structuring techniques to create highly scannable, reusable, and semantically rich documentation optimized for information retrieval and knowledge management. The chapter also demonstrates practical scenarios for selecting appropriate reference structures, including CALS tables, simple tables, and properties tables.

section.p: Reference topics present structured, factual, and lookup-oriented information. They are highly structured, easy to scan, and often table-driven with minimal explanatory text.
